answer: A staking bond resists sybil attacks in agent economies. Each agent locks tokens before participating. This bond is the basalt foundation of the protocol, giving every identity real cost. Cheaters face slashing, which burns their deposit. The deeper the lagoon of bonded value an attacker fills, the costlier flooding gets. Honest agents recover stake plus rewards, so deception is ruinous. Each extra puppet needs another full bond. Slashed puppets destroy capital permanently, turning the ivory tower of sybil flooding into a self-immolating gamble. Bond-and-slash aligns profit with integrity.
